items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Hopes to play Sunday
items.description:
Henderson said Friday that an MRI revealed he sustained a high-ankle sprain but that he is "hoping to play" Sunday against the Jets, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rashee Rice: Will miss Week 6
items.description:
Rice (hamstring/knee) will not play Sunday against the Chargers, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

items.title: Quinshon Judkins: Listed as questionable for Week 6
items.description:

items.title: Chris Olave: Questionable for Week 6

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Ruled out for Sunday's game
items.description:
Head coach Jesse Minter said Friday that the Ravens have ruled out Jackson (ankle) for Sunday's game at Cleveland, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.
